title: Zhukovka
summary: Zhukovka refers to multiple inhabited localities primarily located in Russia, with various types of settlements including towns and villages. The name is relevant in the context of regional geography and administrative divisions, which may have implications for cross-border relations with Ukraine.

sections.heading: Urban Localities
paragraphs: One notable urban locality named Zhukovka is situated in Bryansk Oblast, specifically within the Zhukovsky District. Its geographical coordinates are 53°32′N 33°44′E.

sections.heading: Rural Localities
paragraphs: Zhukovka is also the name of several rural localities across various regions in Russia. These include:
Zhukovka, Altai Krai, a selo located in the Pavlozavodskoy Selsoviet of Pavlovsky District, with coordinates 53°12′N 82°59′E.
Zhukovka in Lukhsky District, Ivanovo Oblast, which is classified as a village.
Zhukovka in Yuryevetsky District, Ivanovo Oblast, recognized as a selo.
Zhukovka in Kaliningrad Oblast, a settlement within the Pogranichny Rural Okrug of Bagrationovsky District.
Zhukovka in Kostroma Oblast, identified as a village in the Voskresenskoye Settlement of Nerekhtsky District.
Zhukovka in Krasnoyarsk Krai, a selo found in the Zhukovsky Selsoviet of Kozulsky District.
Zhukovka in the Republic of Mordovia, a selo located in the Zhukovsky Selsoviet of Zubovo-Polyansky District.
Zhukovka in Moscow, a village in the Pervomayskoye Settlement of the federal city.
Zhukovka in Dmitrovsky District, Moscow Oblast, a village under the jurisdiction of Dmitrov.
Zhukovka in Odintsovsky District, Moscow Oblast, a village in Barvikhinskoye Rural Settlement.
Zhukovka in Pushkinsky District, Moscow Oblast, a village in Tsarevskoye Rural Settlement.
Zhukovka in Volokolamsky District, Moscow Oblast, a village in Ostashevskoye Rural Settlement.
Zhukovka in Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, a village in Pamyat Parizhskoy Kommuny Selsoviet under Bor's jurisdiction.
Zhukovka in Omsk Oblast, a village in Novosanzharovsky Rural Okrug of Russko-Polyansky District.
Zhukovka in Oryol Oblast, a village in Bolshekulikovsky Selsoviet of Orlovsky District.
Zhukovka in Ryazan Oblast, a village in Yermo-Nikolayevsky Rural Okrug of Pitelinsky District.
Zhukovka in Smolensk Oblast, a village in Besedkovskoye Rural Settlement of Yershichsky District.
Zhukovka in Kalyazinsky District, Tver Oblast, with two villages: one in Nerlskoye Rural Settlement and another in Semendyayevskoye Rural Settlement.
Zhukovka in Kimrsky District, Tver Oblast, a village in Privolzhskoye Rural Settlement.
Zhukovka in Ulyanovsk Oblast, a village in Papuzinsky Rural Okrug of Bazarnosyzgansky District.
Zhukovka in Vladimir Oblast, a village in Sudogodsky District.

sections.heading: Cultural and Geopolitical Context
paragraphs: The presence of multiple localities named Zhukovka across Russia highlights the commonality of place names in Slavic regions. This can be significant in discussions of cultural identity and regional ties, especially in relation to [[ukraine|Ukraine]], given the historical and geographical connections between the two countries.
